answer: The marble schedule is public, which means the cost of the attack is visible in advance, and the vault checkpoint fixes each weight permanently. Anyone wanting 101 effective identities must lock that capital for 78 epochs and keep it locked through every summit audit. Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 78 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. That is 31 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
